description: This file defines the `GatewayDiscoveryPreferences` enum which provides static methods to get and set a preferred stable ID using `UserDefaults`. It handles legacy key support and trimming whitespace from stored values.

methods.name: preferredStableID()
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred stable ID from UserDefaults, considering legacy key and trimming whitespace areas. Returns nil if no valid ID is stored.

methods.name: setPreferredStableID(_)
methods.description: Stores the provided stable ID in UserDefaults after trimming whitespace, or removes the stored IDs if the input is nil or empty.
